1	# Core: Shopify App Stack Definition
2	
3	> Source: shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/scaffold-app + shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/cli-for-apps/app-structure
4	> Last extracted: 2026-04-04
5	
6	## Stack B Definition
7	
8	**Framework:** React Router v7 (RECOMMENDED for new apps) OR Remix + TypeScript
9	**UI System:** Polaris Web Components (React Router) or Polaris React v13.9.5 (Remix, archived Jan 2026)
10	**Database:** Prisma + PostgreSQL
11	**Auth:** `@shopify/shopify-app-remix` (session tokens ONLY, never cookies)
12	**API:** Shopify Admin GraphQL (REST deprecated for new apps)
13	**Billing:** Shopify Billing API ONLY (never external processors like Dodo for app charges)
14	**Dev Server:** Port 8080 (Vite or Node)
15	**CLI:** Shopify CLI 3.x (`shopify app dev`, `shopify app deploy`)
16	
17	**Template Selection:**
18	- **New apps:** `shopify-app-template-react-router` (React Router v7 + Polaris Web Components) — GA since Oct 2025
19	- **Existing apps:** Keep Remix + Polaris React v13.9.5 (still works, upgrade when ready)
20	- **App Home:** Web components required (Polaris React does not work here)
21	- **Extensions:** Web components required (theme extensions, checkout UI, functions)
22	
23	## Folder Structure
24	
25	```
26	my-app/
27	├── app/routes/                   # All route handlers (Remix) OR src/routes/ (React Router)
28	│   ├── app._index.tsx            # Dashboard (post-install landing)
29	│   ├── app.settings.tsx          # Settings page
30	│   ├── app.plans.tsx             # Billing/plan selection
31	│   ├── app.tsx                   # Layout wrapper (Polaris)
32	│   ├── auth.$.tsx                # OAuth callback
33	│   ├── auth.login/route.tsx      # Login page
34	│   └── webhooks.tsx              # Webhook handlers (all topics)
35	├── app/components/               # Polaris React (Remix) or regular React (React Router)
36	│   ├── [Feature]Card.tsx
37	│   ├── [Feature]Form.tsx
38	│   └── [Feature]IndexTable.tsx
39	├── app/models/                   # DB models (Prisma helpers)
40	│   ├── Shop.server.ts
41	│   └── [Resource].server.ts
42	├── app/utils/
43	│   ├── shopify.server.ts         # shopifyApp() config
44	│   ├── billing.server.ts         # BILLING_PLANS definition
45	│   └── db.server.ts              # Prisma client
46	├── prisma/
47	│   ├── schema.prisma             # DB schema
48	│   └── migrations/               # Version-controlled SQL
49	├── extensions/                   # Web components ONLY (theme, checkout, functions)
50	│   ├── theme-app-extension/      # Liquid blocks + web components
51	│   ├── checkout-ui/              # Checkout extensions (Preact)
52	│   └── function/                 # Shopify Functions (Rust/JS)
53	├── shopify.app.toml              # MANDATORY app config

56	├── package.json

58	```

60	## shopify.app.toml (MANDATORY)
61	
62	**Required fields:**
63	```toml
64	scopes = "write_products,read_products,write_orders,read_orders"  # Your app's access
65	name = "My App"
66	type = "public|custom"     # public for App Store, custom for single merchant
67	handle = "my-unique-app"   # Unique identifier
68	webhooks.api_version = "2025-01"  # Supported version (not deprecated within 90 days)
69	
70	# Webhook subscriptions (auto-registered on deploy)
71	[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
72	topics = ["orders/create", "products/update"]
73	uri = "https://myapp.com/webhooks"
74	
75	# Billing (if monetized)
76	[billing]
77	# Plans defined here or via API
78	
79	# Extensions reference
80	[build]
81	include_config_on_deploy = ["extensions/*/shopify.extension.toml"]
82	```
83	
84	## Auth Flow (Non-Negotiable)
85	
86	1. **Session tokens ONLY** — never cookies, never bearer tokens in frontend
87	2. **Every loader/action MUST authenticate first:**
88	   ```typescript
89	   const { admin, session, billing } = await authenticate.admin(request);
90	   const shop = session.shop;  // ONLY valid shop identifier
91	   ```
92	3. **Always scope data by shop:**
93	   ```typescript
94	   const data = await prisma.resource.findMany({
95	     where: { shop },  // Critical for multi-tenancy
96	   });
97	   ```
98	
99	## Polaris UI Rules (App Store Requirement)
100	
101	- **MANDATORY:** Use Polaris ONLY for admin UI
102	- **Remix apps:** `@shopify/polaris` React components v13.9.5 (archived but functional)
103	- **React Router apps:** Polaris Web Components + CDN: `<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/shopifycloud/polaris.js"></script>`
104	- **App Home:** Web components required (Polaris React does not work)
105	- **Extensions:** Web components required for all extension types
106	- **NO alternatives:** Tailwind, shadcn, custom CSS for admin layouts
107	- **Page structure:** Every route uses `<Page>` (or `<shopify-page>`) + `<Layout>` + `<Card>` pattern
108	- **Responsive:** Polaris handles desktop/mobile automatically
109	- **Theming:** Merchants' brand colors auto-apply via Polaris
110	
111	**Invalid:**
112	```typescript
113	// ❌ WRONG — will cause App Store rejection
114	import styled from 'styled-components';
115	import { Card } from '@myui/components';
116	```
117	
118	**Valid (Remix + Polaris React):**
119	```typescript
120	// ✅ CORRECT
121	import { Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack } from '@shopify/polaris';
122	```
123	
124	**Valid (React Router + Web Components):**
125	```html
126	<!-- ✅ CORRECT -->
127	<shopify-page>
128	  <shopify-layout>
129	    <shopify-layout-section>
130	      <shopify-card></shopify-card>
131	    </shopify-layout-section>
132	  </shopify-layout>
133	</shopify-page>
134	```
135	
136	## Billing (Shopify Billing API Only)
137	
138	**CRITICAL:** Shopify Billing API is the ONLY approved payment method for app charges.
139	
140	- External payment processors (Dodo Payments, Stripe, etc.) are NOT allowed for app subscriptions
141	- Merchant billing flows use `@shopify/shopify-app-remix` billing helpers
142	- Plans defined in `shopify.app.toml` or via API
143	- Trial days configurable per plan
144	- Free tier must not block core functionality (App Store requirement)
145	
146	## GDPR Webhooks (MANDATORY)
147	
148	Every app MUST implement three webhooks — required even if app stores NO user data:
149	
150	**CRITICAL: GDPR webhooks are NOT registered in shopify.app.toml.**
151	They are configured in Shopify Partner Dashboard > App Setup > Privacy.
152	Adding `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, or `shop/redact` to TOML
153	causes deploy error: "The following topic is invalid".
154	
155	**Configuration:**
156	1. Go to Shopify Partner Dashboard > App > Configuration > Privacy
157	2. Set the GDPR webhook URLs there (e.g. `/webhooks/customers/data_request`)
158	3. Create route handler files in `app/routes/` for each topic
159	4. Add a TOML comment documenting where GDPR webhooks are configured
160	
161	```toml
162	# GDPR compliance webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact)
163	# are NOT registered here — they are configured in Shopify Partner Dashboard > App setup > Privacy.
164	# Route handlers exist at: webhooks.customers.data_request.tsx, webhooks.customers.redact.tsx, webhooks.shop.redact.tsx
165	```
166	
167	Handlers must:
168	- **customers/data_request:** Export all customer PII held by app
169	- **customers/redact:** Delete all customer data (async is fine)
170	- **shop/redact:** Delete all shop data on app uninstall (delete ALL models scoped to that shop)
171	
172	## App Bridge (Embedded Apps)
173	
174	**REQUIRED for all embedded apps:**
175	- `@shopify/app-bridge-react` for React components
176	- Nav menu, modals, toasts, and session tokens via App Bridge
177	- Session tokens expire every 1 minute — fetch fresh for each request
178	
179	## Key Safety Rules
180	
181	1. **Never use cookies** — session tokens ONLY
182	2. **Never hardcode secrets** — API key/secret via env vars ONLY
183	3. **Shop-scoped data mandatory** — every DB query filters by `session.shop`
184	4. **Polaris mandatory** — no exceptions for admin UI
185	5. **Shopify Billing mandatory** — no external payment for app charges
186	6. **HTTPS mandatory** — HTTP rejected in production
187	7. **API version locked** — update per deploy, never deprecated
188	
189	## Template Selection Guide
190	
191	### New Apps (Recommended)
192	```bash
193	# React Router v7 + Polaris Web Components (GA since Oct 2025)
194	shopify app init --template=react-router
195	```
196	
197	### Existing Apps (Backward Compatible)

199	# Remix + Polaris React v13.9.5 (still works, archival announced Jan 2026)

201	```

206	# Scaffold new app (React Router recommended)
207	shopify app init --template=react-router
208	# OR legacy
209	shopify app init --flavor=remix

226	## 2025-2026 Breaking Changes & Updates
227	
228	> Added: 2026-04-10. Sources: shopify.dev, Polaris blog, Shopify changelog.
229	
230	### API & Platform Changes
231	- **April 1, 2025**: REST Admin API deprecated. GraphQL Admin API REQUIRED for all new apps.
232	- **January 1, 2026**: Legacy custom apps no longer allowed. All apps must be public/reviewed.
233	- **Billing API**: Now requires line items structure for all pricing models (flat-rate removed).
234	
235	### App Bridge CDN Migration (July 2025)
236	- npm package (`@shopify/app-bridge`) is in **maintenance mode**.
237	- Required: CDN script tag for Built for Shopify status.
238	```html
239	<meta name="shopify-api-key" content="%SHOPIFY_API_KEY%" />
240	<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/shopifycloud/app-bridge.js"></script>
241	```
242	- Trade-off: Auto-updates (always latest) vs. less control over timing.
243	
244	### Polaris Web Components Unification (October 2025)
245	- Version 2025-07 was the LAST to support React components.
246	- v2025-10+ uses Polaris web components only for extensions.
247	- Standard HTML attributes in markup; property access on DOM elements.
248	- Responsive values via container queries: `@container (inline-size > 500px) large, small`.
249	- Commands API: `commandFor` attribute controls components declaratively.
250	
251	### Checkout Extensions Migration
252	- React-based checkout UI extensions DEPRECATED.
253	- v2025-10+ requires web components only.
254	- Components inherit merchant brand settings — CSS cannot be overridden.
255	- Block targets allow flexible placement anywhere in checkout.
256	
257	### Checkout Validation Functions (2025-01+)
258	- Server-side validation for checkout (supports express checkouts).
259	- Max 25 validation functions per store.
260	- Field-level targeting: `$.cart.deliveryGroups[0].deliveryAddress.postalCode`.
261	- JavaScript or Rust implementation.
262	- Use cases: tokengating, B2B minimums, PO validation, billing restrictions.
263	
264	### App Store Approval (Updated 2025-2026)
265	- Response times: <500ms for 95% of requests.
266	- Lighthouse: no more than 10-point drop from Shopify admin baseline.
267	- App Bridge: must use latest version for Built for Shopify status.
268	
269	### Hydrogen + Storefront MCP (Winter 2026)
270	- AI-native commerce framework with Storefront MCP.
271	- AI assistants can query real-time product data, manage carts, guide checkout.
272	- React + Tailwind + GraphQL Storefront API + Oxygen hosting.
273	- Mobile performance: 90+ Lighthouse vs traditional themes 60-75.
274	- Agentic commerce features rolling out March 2026.
